deck.description: Code fences, tables, diagrams, and unicode inside card text.

cards.front:
What does this output tell you?

```
O    10.1.1.0/24 [110/20] via 192.168.1.2, 00:01:10, GigabitEthernet0/1
```
cards.back:
It is an **OSPF** route (code `O`) with administrative distance 110 and metric 20.

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `110` | administrative distance |
| `20` | OSPF cost |

cards.front:
Which router is the DR in this topology?

```mermaid
graph LR
  R1[R1 priority 1] --- SW
  R2[R2 priority 100] --- SW
  R3[R3 priority 50] --- SW
```
cards.back: R2, because it has the highest priority.
